# All v0.8 comparison metrics

Each cell is the median [minimum, maximum] of three fresh-process trials. Incomplete groups have no passing median. Full samples and paired ratio intervals are in [the JSON summary](data/summary-mac-3pct.json). CPU zeroes reflect coarse counters; echo traffic is not saturated throughput. Higher bulk throughput is better; other metrics are lower-is-better.
